'''Huge skeletons''' are monsters that appear in the second and third sections of [[The Shadow Reef]]. They are stronger than their [[Summoned skeleton|smaller counterparts]], possessing higher health and damage.

*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50
